mechanism: Actor encoder concatenates normalized price/indicator history with account features into a 2×LatentCount layer then samples a stochastic latent st via VAE; EntropyLatentState reparameterizes K=32 draws from learned (μ,σ), appends current latent, and scores nuclear-norm entropy S.sum/(||X||F·max(dims)) as an exploration/diversity intrinsic reward alongside action-policy entropy.
data_needed: HistoryBars×BarDescr OHLC/volume/RSI/CCI/ATR/MACD; AccountDescr; LatentCount VAE means/vars; SamplLatentStates draws; SVD of stacked latents.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train first 7 months 2023; test August 2023; default RSI/CCI/ATR/MACD
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a stochastic latent-state diversity sensor: how multimodal/uncertain the encoded market+account state is under partial observability—usable as regime-ambiguity or exploration-need feature.
quote: the use of latent variables in the Agent's policy significantly increases its expressiveness and ability to model stochasticity in observations and rewards

mechanism: Random convolutional encoder embeds each replay state; KNNReward finds k nearest embeddings by L2, distance-weights their rewards (1−log(d+1)), and adds nuclear-norm of the (neighbors+query) embedding matrix as intrinsic reward—state-similarity sensing for credit assignment.
data_needed: Full replay-buffer state embeddings from Convolution net; k; reward matrix aligned to embeddings.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; NNM+SMAC Study EA; ~360k states after 100+50 passes
why_new_for_mis: Embedding-neighborhood distance sensor of how familiar the current market state is versus historical visited states—regime-familiarity / novelty feature without supervised labels.
quote: we determine the distance from the predicted state to the actual examples from the experience reproduction buffer

mechanism: CNeuronEmbeddingOCL maps five modalities (BarDescr×NBarInPattern price/indicators, AccountDescr, TimeDescription harmonics, NRewards RTG, NActions) into a shared EmbeddingSize space with per-modality FC+normalize and stack_size history; sparse MH attention over the sequence predicts actions conditioned on desired Return-To-Go rather than past reward.
data_needed: Last-bar OHLC deltas, tick_volume/1000, RSI/CCI/ATR/MACD; account balance/equity/positions; sin/cos time stamps; RTG vector; prior action; HistoryBars embedding stack.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train 7 months 2023; test August 2023
why_new_for_mis: Autoregressive multi-modal sequence sensor that treats desired future return as a conditioning token—MIS can use RTG-conditioned trajectory embeddings as goal-aware regime/path features.
quote: we want the model to generate actions based on future desired rewards, rather than past rewards

mechanism: Separate RTG-generation net predicts return-to-go from current multimodal state; Actor conditions on predicted RTG; OnlineStudy fine-tunes every StudyPeriod bars (default 120≈1 week on H1) with duplicate models and soft WeightsUpdate so embedding-stack continuity is preserved while policy adapts to non-stationary market.
data_needed: Live H1 bars+indicators; trajectory replay buffer; Agent+RTG study copies; StudyPeriod/StudyIters.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; StudyPeriod=120; offline DT/DoC pretrained then ODT fine-tune; test Aug 2023 ~10%
why_new_for_mis: Operational regime-drift adaptation sensor: when and how much the conditional return model and policy need online refresh under changing market—change-detection via periodic fine-tune schedule.
quote: in everyday work, it is advisable to use more thoughtful approaches to shift the additional training to periods of market closure or reduction in instrument volatility

mechanism: Single trajectory encoder (batch-norm→EmbeddingOCL→sparse attention→MLP) outputs 2×EmbeddingSize (μ,σ); World model VAE-samples latent, concatenates trajectory embedding, predicts NRewards; Agent decodes actions from World hidden state; multiple candidates ranked by predicted return—latent meant to capture env trends vs high-level intentions without full multi-step world rollouts.
data_needed: BarDescr×NBarInPattern+Account+Time+Actions trajectory; Agents candidate count; latent[2×EmbeddingSize] stored in SState.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train 7 months 2023; test Aug 2023; Agents=5; sparse 8-head×4-layer attention
why_new_for_mis: Stochastic latent that separates environment-mode/trend uncertainty from policy intention—MIS regime sensor for cautious vs optimistic candidate ranking under optimism bias.
quote: latent variables of the environmental model should correspond to various possible trends and the most likely change in its state

mechanism: Value net takes ValueBars×BarDescr raw OHLC/volume/RSI/CCI/ATR/MACD, batch-norms, convolves per-candle, MLP→NRewards; trained to predict cumulative reward over a short planning horizon (not discounted episode end)—author frames it as sensing market intensity rather than trend direction for RTG conditioning of hierarchical DT scheduler.
data_needed: ValueBars consecutive bars of BarDescr features; target = rewards[i+ValueBars-1]−rewards[i+2×ValueBars-1]·γ^ValueBars.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; hierarchical CT with Worker skills (512) + DT scheduler; test Aug 2023 PF 1.13
why_new_for_mis: Short-horizon intensity/potential sensor from multi-bar microstructure+indicator window—vol/activity context for RTG without claiming long-horizon trend foresight.
quote: we are not interested in trends in this case. Instead, we focus on market intensity

mechanism: FutureEmbedding encodes ValueBars of upcoming price/indicator bars (no account/actions/rewards) via batch-norm→sparse attention→SoftMax embedding Z; Planner predicts Z from current single-bar state only; Actor conditions on Z instead of RTG—unsupervised future-conditioned target that later fine-tuning associates with returns via RTG head.
data_needed: BarDescr×NBarInPattern×ValueBars future window; current bar for Planner; EmbeddingSize SoftMax Z.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; PDT Pretrain/FineTune; unlabeled Go-Explore buffer from part 62; test Aug 2023 PF≈1.03
why_new_for_mis: Future-window embedding sensor: compresses near-term market path geometry into a latent target usable without reward labels—sequence foresight feature for MIS.
quote: PDT jointly learns an embedding space of future trajectory as well as a future prior conditioned only on past information

mechanism: GetProbTrajectories normalizes pass returns to (0,1], applies exp(|r−max|/(p90−max))·r/(r+λ) weights and samples high-return trajectories preferentially; on high-quantile passes, Noise(std,multiplyer) adds positive RTG noise so adjusted RTG≥max train return, then L2-penalizes action deviation—conservative OOD-goal regularization.
data_needed: Replay trajectories with States[0].rewards totals; λ; quantile q≈0.95; reward-component std vector.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; CWBC StudyAgent+StudyRTG; train 7m 2023; test Aug; PF≈1.11 after one downstream iter
why_new_for_mis: Return-distribution reweighting plus OOD RTG stress sensor—flags when conditioned goals leave support of observed outcomes; useful reliability/regime-edge feature for BC-style sensors.
quote: the policy must be conservative... stay close to the original data distribution in order to avoid a catastrophic failure when specifying an RTG outside the distribution

mechanism: Random-conv Encoder embeds (HistoryBars×BarDescr + AccountDescr); GetTargets computes soft distances dist=LogSumExp_α(|e−ei|) over dataset, keeps percentile-nearest neighbors, SoftMax(−dist)-weights their rewards and LogSumExp-advantage-weights their actions—supervised cloning along shortest in-dataset paths.
data_needed: State embedding matrix; aligned rewards/actions; percentile k; temperature α=max abs diff.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; DWSL Study; ~500 random then iterated trajectories; test Aug 2023 PF 1.3
why_new_for_mis: Soft minimum path-distance sensor in embedding space between current market state and historical states—goal-conditioned familiarity / shortest-path regime feature.
quote: DWSL estimates distances using supervised learning... Then uses this distribution to estimate the minimum distance to the target contained in each state's dataset

mechanism: Exploratory Actors train online with only intrinsic reward: Convolution embeds (state‖account‖action); ResearchReward takes quantile-nearest prior state-action embeddings, scores nuclear-norm diversity + latent entropy—maximizes coverage of state-action space before extrinsic relabeling (ExORL stages 1–2).
data_needed: Growing state_embeddings matrix; Quant; Actor+fixed Critic+shared Encoder; Agent id for parallel explorers.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; ResearchExORL parallel agents; unlabeled then DWSL-style offline train
why_new_for_mis: Explicit state-action coverage/novelty sensor for offline datasets—MIS can score how well a window explores vs exploits known market-action support.
quote: the use of diverse data can greatly simplify offline reinforcement learning algorithms by eliminating the need to handle the extrapolation problem

mechanism: CDeal/CDeals load MQL5 Signals CSV histories; map each bar’s open to volume/TP/SL action vectors (bar-aligned, TP/SL inferred from close vs open); attach EURUSD H1 OHLC/volume/RSI/CCI/ATR/MACD+account features—heterogeneous expert trajectories as realistic offline coverage of the same environment.
data_needed: Signals\SignalX.csv deal histories; symbol point; H1 Rates+indicators; Agent id for parallel conversion.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 first 7 months 2023; 20 signals initially then +200 policy trajectories; test Aug PF 1.34
why_new_for_mis: Sensing via multi-source expert trajectory coverage of real market states—diversifies offline support beyond random EA passes without claiming signal cloning.
quote: the only criterion for signals is the presence of transactions during the historical period of the training period for the selected financial instrument

mechanism: Scheduler DT embeds (price/indicators, account, time, last action)→EmbeddingSize preference context Z stored in SState.scheduler; Agent DT conditions on Z; trajectory preference labeled by pass Profit (pair-preference via CWBC-style weights)—replaces scalar RTG with high-dim task context.
data_needed: Per-bar multimodal state; EmbeddingSize Z; trajectory Profit for preference; Scheduler+Agent nets.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; OPPO StudyScheduler/StudyAgent; profit-based preference proxy
why_new_for_mis: High-dimensional preference/context sensor instead of scalar reward bottleneck—MIS task-intent embedding from trajectory comparisons.
quote: This high-dimensional Z-space captures more information about the task at hand compared to a scalar payoff

mechanism: CVAE Encoder: batch-norm+conv SoftMax on HistoryBars×BarDescr, concatenate actions, VAE latent; Decoder concatenates latent with (normalized) state key and reconstructs actions; reconstruction error / log-density lower bound regularizes Actor to stay in training-support (SPOT density constraint).
data_needed: Replay state-action pairs; Encoder/Decoder; Actor actions proposed under new policy for density penalty λ.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; SPOT StudyCVAE then policy Study on Real-ORL-style buffers
why_new_for_mis: Behavioral density / support OOD sensor: how far proposed actions under current market state sit from observed data density—critical offline reliability and regime-edge gate.
quote: when we feed into the model initial data that is far from the distribution of the training dataset... this leads to a significant increase in the data decoding error
